summary: Applies an X-axis rotation to columns 1 and 2 of a 3x3 double matrix (this, 9 doubles at 8-byte stride): each column pair is recombined with sin/cos of angle a2 while column 0 is unchanged. If a3 is non-null, Euler angles are extracted to a3: -this[5] is written at a3+0 after FloatConvertWrapper, then either the gimbal-lock path (fabs(this[5]) == 1.0, using the dbl_59E420 constant) or the regular atan2 path fills a3+8 and a3+16. Used in vehicle physics suspension orientation setup; called by SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine.

local_names.this: 3x3 double rotation matrix (elements this[0..8] at byte offsets 0x0, 0x8, 0x10, 0x18, 0x20, 0x28, 0x30, 0x38, 0x40)
local_names.a2: rotation angle (radians) around the X axis
local_names.a3: optional output buffer for extracted Euler angles (written at a3+0, a3+8, a3+16, a3+20); skipped when null

operations.description: Compute v3 = sin(a2) and v5 = cos(a2).
Rotate matrix column 1: this[1] (offset 0x8) = this[1]*cos + this[2]*sin; this[2] (offset 0x10) = this[2]*cos - this[1]*sin.
Rotate matrix column 2: this[4] (offset 0x20) = this[4]*cos + this[5]*sin; this[5] (offset 0x28) = this[5]*cos - this[4]*sin.
Rotate matrix column 3: this[7] (offset 0x38) = this[7]*cos + this[8]*sin; this[8] (offset 0x40) = this[8]*cos - this[7]*sin. Column 0 elements (0x0, 0x18, 0x30) are left unchanged.
If a3 is non-null, perform Euler-angle extraction; otherwise the function ends after the rotation.
Capture v12 = this[5] (offset 0x28), call FloatConvertWrapper(this), then write the double value -v12 at a3+0.
Gimbal-lock branch: if fabs(this[5]) == 1.0 (the 1.0 constant, matching the read-only double global dbl_59E420), use the singularity Euler path; otherwise use the regular atan2 path.
Gimbal-lock path: write a3+8 = atan2(-this[6], this[0]) (elements this 0x30 and 0x0) and zero the DWORDs at a3+16 and a3+20.
Regular path: write a3+8 = atan2(this[2], this[8]) (elements this 0x10 and 0x40) and a3+16 = atan2(this[3], this[4]) (elements this 0x18 and 0x20).

clean_pseudocode: // Right-multiply 3x3 double matrix by Rx(a2): rotate columns 1 and 2.
unresolved: The decompiled element types mix double reads and long-double writes for the same 8-byte matrix elements; the 8-byte element stride is inferred from the offsets and matches a double matrix.

The layout of the a3 output buffer is not asserted beyond the written offsets (a3+0, a3+8, a3+16, a3+20), and the mixed double/DWORD writes at a3+16/a3+20 in the gimbal branch are taken verbatim from the source.
The in-place semantics of FloatConvertWrapper(this) are not analyzed here; only the captured pre-conversion value of this[5] is used for the a3+0 write.
